Mode 2: pileup whole chromosome(s) without given SNPs
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
This mode genotypes single cells or bulk sample on whole chromosomes, without
given SNPs. 

Recommend filtering SNPs with <100UMIs or <10% minor alleles for saving space 
and speed up inference when pileup whole genome: 
``--minMAF 0.1 --minCOUNT 100``.

#!/bin/sh

DAT_DIR=/hps/nobackup/stegle/users/huangh/donorID/genotypes/genome1K

### download data
mkdir $DAT_DIR/chroms
cd $DAT_DIR/chroms
for chr in `seq 1 22`
do
    echo $chr
    file=ALL.chr$chr.phase3_shapeit2_mvncall_integrated_v5a.20130502.genotypes.vcf.gz
    wget ftp://ftp.1000genomes.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/ftp/release/20130502/$file
    wget ftp://ftp.1000genomes.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/ftp/release/20130502/$file.tbi
done
